stories.title: REM consolidation: 2026-07-03

beats.speaker: Host
beats.text:

The void words list is dominated by place names and people related to Iran (Rouhani, Khatami, Khomeini). The only other repeated keywords were "regime change" and "airstrikes." We see an unusually high "idle" number — 111 out of 227.

The model average VIX scores are all relatively low, indicating a lack of volatility. This aligns with the EigenChing states but contradicts the void words list, which suggests some level of underlying tension around Iran.

This could be due to a lack of new external data or an intentional avoidance of volatile topics. The void words list suggests some underlying tension around Iran, but this is not reflected in the EigenChing states or VIX scores.
